items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Hank Mobley used to come in there.

ctx.x: times on the radio that he worked there with me. And he even put it on the back of albums, which I thought was nice. And of course Lou Donaldson was there and Blue Mitchell, he became quite prominent. And I was with Max Roach the other day; they were having Betty Carter Day at the Oval Office in Washington, D.C., it was Betty Carter Day. So Betty remembered the Paradise, 'cause I hired her for eight straight months in the Paradise. She had a hard time because they called her Betty Bebop Carter and the "Bebop"…

records and he's quite prominent and Lou Donaldson works all the time and Blue Mitchell just died and Hank Mobley used to come in there. Then Sonny Rollins, Sonny Rollins used to come in there. He became quite prominent. And Clifford Jordan used to come in there all the time. And Phil Woods; I saw him out in Denver. He's doing well, you know, he was a young kid. And Zoot Sims used to come up there all the time and we talk. When I see the guys, and McGhee, we talk about the days and laugh, you know. Max and I…
[D.F.: Is there anything you would like to say to sum things up here for the interview?]
